Geographies Served Programs Shelter Homes District North West Delhi Pune Palghar Mumbai State Delhi Maharashtra District North West Delhi Pune Palghar Mumbai States Delhi Maharashtra The Foundation runs four shelter homes in the cities of Mumbai, Boisar, Pune and Delhi respectively. Each of the homes provides a safe, protected space for the rescued girls and includes facilities like training halls, computer labs, entertainment centres and dining halls. The girls are looked after by the Foundation through regular health check-ups, excursions, where girls from all four homes come together and go on an annual trip, yoga and meditation sessions, martial arts training and theatre workshops. Vocational training is arranged for the girls which includes spoken English, jewellery making, bag making, beautician courses, tailoring and computer training. Based on the duration of stay granted by judicial courts, the girls are also encouraged to continue, and if possible, complete their education while staying in the shelter.
